children: Constellation Software had two underlying operational soft spots that overshadowed an otherwise in-line quarter. Steven Li of Raymond James notes in a report that, first, maintenance organic revenue growth came in at 4%. While a sequential improvement from 2% in the prior quarter, the print remains subdued compared to historical trends, held back by customer consolidation across U.S. hospitals and persistent churn at its Altera unit. Second, cash flow looked thin, with operating cash flow of $717 million and free cash flow of $443 million fell well short of consensus, though Li chalks the shortfall up to the timing and integration of recent acquisitions. Shares are down 6.5% to C$3,296.62. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
